opportunities.name: Movie research (IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes) and email a movie-night invite
opportunities.description: Look up a movie title on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes, then compose a mail message to a friend with the title, director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer, and discard the draft.
steps: Open IMDb, click the search box, type the movie title, press Enter
Open the matching title page and read director, runtime and IMDb rating
Open Rotten Tomatoes, click the search box, type the title, press Enter
Open the matching title and read the Tomatometer score
Open the mail compose form and enter the recipient in To
Enter 'Movie night <day>: <title>' as the Subject
Type the body with recipient name, day, title, director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer
Click Discard (or Send)

instances.values: Arrival -> lena@example.com, Friday, Denis Villeneuve, 1h56m, IMDb 7.9, Tomatometer 94%
Spirited Away -> tom@example.com, Saturday, Hayao Miyazaki, 2h4m, IMDb 8.6, Tomatometer 96%

opportunities.name: npm package stats lookup saved to Notes
opportunities.description: Search an npm package, open its page and GitHub repo releases, then save a note with version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues and last release date.
steps: Open npmjs.com, click the package search box
Type the package name and press Enter
Open the matching package result
Read version, weekly downloads and license
Click the GitHub repository link
Open the Releases section and read stars, open issues and last release date
Open Notes, click New note
Type '<package>: <version>, <downloads>/week, <license>, <stars> stars, <issues> open issues, last release <date>' and press Enter

instances.values: lodash (after correcting typo 'lodahs') -> v4.18.1, 131,289,453/week, MIT, 61.4k stars, 56 issues

opportunities.name: Recipe research (Allrecipes + Wikipedia) saved to Notes
opportunities.description: Search a dish on Allrecipes, open the top recipe, check the dish's origin on Wikipedia, and save a note with servings, rating, time, key ingredients and origin.
steps: Open Allrecipes, click the recipe search box
Type the dish name and press Enter
Open the top recipe result and read rating, time and ingredients
Open Wikipedia, click the search box
Type the dish name and press Enter, read the origin
Open Notes, click New note
Type '<dish> for <n>: <recipe> (<rating> stars, <time>), needs <ingredients>. Origin: <origin>' and press Enter

instances.values: shakshuka -> Chef John's Shakshuka, 4.8 stars, 50 mins, Ottoman North Africa
pad thai -> Pad Thai, 4.0 stars, 45 mins, Thailand
